crownlands.settingPhrase: sunlit wheat roads, orchards, and green oak groves
crownlands.roadPhrase: farm carts and royal road couriers

saltmarsh.settingPhrase: fog-hung reeds, tidal sandbars, and brackish flats
saltmarsh.roadPhrase: fishing skiffs and marsh supply wagons

thornwall.settingPhrase: ochre highland hills, slate quarries, and stony passes
thornwall.roadPhrase: ore trains and border garrison patrols

weald.settingPhrase: dense mossy timber woods and shadowed clearings

desert.settingPhrase: blistering golden dunes, sandstone mesas, and salt coves

highlands.settingPhrase: wind-scoured granite ridges, pine valleys, and storm peaks
highlands.roadPhrase: star-iron wagons and mountain watch scouts

frostbound.settingPhrase: frozen snowfields, icebound pines, and glacial cliffs
frostbound.roadPhrase: winter fur-sleds and northern harbor convoys

dreadwaste.settingPhrase: charred ash plains, jagged basalt crags, and obsidian passes
dreadwaste.roadPhrase: siege-line pickets and vanguard supply columns

mob_bandit.threatSummary: Desperate Bandits slipped clear of capital watch patrols after King Garrick fled north. Now they ambush grain wagons along open dirt roads and plunder local harvests unless driven out.

mob_acolyte.threatSummary: Disgraced temple Acolytes fell to whispers seeping through Ethoria's fractured Portals. They raise makeshift altars beside rural roads to prey on travelers and feed dark wards.

mob_cultist.threatSummary: Hooded Cultists wearing blackened sigils shelter inside overgrown woods and roadside ruins. Left unchecked, their blood-rites call wild rift beasts straight toward town palisades.

mob_wolf.threatSummary: Hungry Wolves were driven out of deep forest hollows by strange rift tremors. They now stalk grazing sheep, farm mules, and lone couriers at dusk.

mob_giant_crab.threatSummary: Swollen offshore currents drove monstrous Giant Crabs onto dry ground. They crush coastal skiffs and snap crabbers' traps clean in half.

byRegion.crownlands: Swollen offshore currents drove monstrous Giant Crabs onto Crown Sea tide-flats. They crush fishermen's wicker traps and snip at wade-line patrols.
byRegion.saltmarsh: Monstrous Giant Crabs nest across muddy saltmarsh bars and tidal flats. They clamp onto stranded boats and ambush unwary marsh gatherers.
byRegion.thornwall: Rough tides drove Giant Crabs onto Thornwall's sheltered cove rocks. They crush cargo crates and scatter harbor haulers landing border iron.

mob_skeleton.threatSummary: Restless Skeletons from forgotten skirmishes clawed their way out of hilltop barrows. Armed with rusted steel, they march blindly upon every living traveler.

mob_zombie.threatSummary: Creeping necrotic haze off shallow graves dragged shambling Zombies back upright. Though slow, they swarm stubbornly over country trails until put down cleanly.

mob_scout.threatSummary: Fleet-footed deserter Scouts traded royal garrison service for highway plunder. From hillside rises they spot passing supply wagons early and signal ambushers in.

mob_thug.threatSummary: Heavy-shouldered Thugs stretch spiked chains across open crossroads. They shake down honest farmers for every silver piece before letting wagons pass.

mob_spy.threatSummary: Poison-bladed Spies slip between rural inns and crossroads to map out garrison patrol schedules. Catching them in the wilds cuts the eyes and ears off outlaw rings.

mob_shadow.threatSummary: Living Shadows peel free from stone hollows at twilight. Their numbing touch drains a traveler's warmth and leaves even stout sentries trembling.

mob_worg.threatSummary: Cruel Worgs bark broken commands as they herd pack horses into narrow blind gullies. Travelers trapped inside rarely ride clear.

mob_pirate.threatSummary: Salt-hardened Pirates beach stolen skiffs in quiet coves under cover of sea spray. They raid watch-posts and strip cargo barges to the ribs.

mob_ghoul.threatSummary: Starved undead Ghouls haunt shadowed hollows and paralyze victims on contact with filthy claws. Rangers must clear their hunting grounds before trails close.

mob_dire_wolf.threatSummary: Shoulder-high Dire Wolves can snap oak wagon shafts with a single bite. Their booming howls rally lesser packs into fearless assaults on patrols.

mob_giant_spider.threatSummary: Horse-sized Giant Spiders string razor-tough silk traps between ancient trees. Unwary trappers vanish into the canopy without a cry.

mob_brown_bear.threatSummary: Massive Brown Bears grew furious after foul Portal scents drifted across wild berry slopes. Cornered near grazing pastures, a single bear scatters an entire guard detail.

mob_harpy.threatSummary: Screaming Harpies perch on high cliff ledges to lure watchmen and drovers toward steep drops. Travelers drawn in by their haunting song meet diving talons.

mob_bandit_captain.threatSummary: Seasoned Bandit Captains whip loose highwaymen into disciplined ambush companies. Cutting down their leaders shatters outlaw morale across the county.

mob_cultist_fanatic.threatSummary: Wild-eyed Cultist Fanatics channel twisted rift blessings and roar dark invocations over rocky ledges. Every fanatic left alive rallies fresh cells across the frontier.

mob_gargoyle.threatSummary: Earth-Plane tremors woke winged granite Gargoyles perched atop high ridge spires. They stay motionless like broken statues until patrols march past below.

mob_berserker.threatSummary: Scarred Berserkers drink stinging battle-brews and charge straight into shield walls heedless of steel or pain. Patrols cannot hold local trails while they roam free.

mob_ghast.threatSummary: Putrid undead Ghasts reek of grave rot so foul it turns brave soldiers' stomachs mid-swing. Clearing them keeps vital marshland causeways open.

mob_giant_constrictor_snake.threatSummary: Thirty-foot Giant Constrictor Snakes glide noiselessly through tall brush and waterways. They coil out of murky banks to drag wading scouts and pack mules under.

mob_ogre.threatSummary: Nine-foot Ogres haul uprooted tree trunks down from rocky ridges. They smash supply wagons open for salted meat and scrap iron.

mob_merrow.threatSummary: Barbed sea-born Merrow washed inland along coastal waters. Armed with jagged bone harpoons, they hunt fishermen and coastal scouts along wet shores.

mob_werewolf.threatSummary: Cursed Werewolves prowl under dusk mist along marsh and woodland verges. No watch-post sleeps soundly while their howls circle nearby.

mob_black_dragon_wyrmling.threatSummary: Cruel horned Black Dragon Wyrmlings crept out of murky coastal pools. They delight in melting armor plates and boat hulls with blistering green acid.

mob_warrior_veteran.threatSummary: Hardened Warrior Veterans abandoned royal service to sell seasoned sword-work to smugglers and rival houses. Inexperienced county levies buckle whenever they charge.

mob_knight.threatSummary: Full-plate rogue Knights ride through borderlands to impose illegal blood-tolls on passing merchants in King Garrick's darkest name.

mob_minotaur.threatSummary: Towering bull-headed Minotaurs wandered into rugged defiles and forest ruins. They charge straight down narrow tracks where wagons have nowhere to turn.

mob_manticore.threatSummary: Winged Manticores loose salvos of iron-hard tail quills from high cliff updrafts. Entire baggage convoys lie pinned down across exposed passes.

mob_winter_wolf.threatSummary: Massive pale-furred Winter Wolves spilled out through unnatural cold rifts onto Thornwall's high crag passes. Their frost gusts freeze wary border patrols where they stand.

mob_wight.threatSummary: Vengeful undead Wights clad in corroded border armor stalk disputed grasslands. Their chilling blades wither living vitality on contact.

mob_vampire_familiar.threatSummary: Pale blood-bound Vampire Familiars slip across grasslands between dusk and dawn. They mark lonely homesteads for darker masters.

mob_hell_hound.threatSummary: Coal-eyed Hell Hounds run loose across dry brush and forest margins. Their smoking tracks end at wooden watchtowers torched in seconds.

mob_basilisk.threatSummary: Heavy eight-legged Basilisks squat silently among rocky outcrops. Their toxic yellow glare turns unwary prospectors into pale limestone statues.

mob_mummy.threatSummary: Linen-shrouded Mummies woke inside cracked burial tombs. Their rotting touch drives ancient dust-blight straight into mortal veins.

mob_red_dragon_wyrmling.threatSummary: Proud crimson Red Dragon Wyrmlings claimed nearby slate mine shafts. They scorch pick-gangs away to hoard bright iron and silver inside smoldering caves.

mob_ettin.threatSummary: Snarling two-headed Ettins guard boulder choke-points with dual morningstars. Both heads bicker endlessly over which traveler gets roasted first.

mob_bearded_devil.threatSummary: Spiteful iron-glaive Bearded Devils crawled out of warfront rifts. Their writhing serpent beards leave festering wounds no ordinary field bandage closes.

mob_guard_captain.threatSummary: Ruthless rival Guard Captains drill hostile patrols across disputed border roads. Left in command, they cut loyalist settlements clean off from supplies.

mob_green_hag.threatSummary: Cruel canopy-dwelling Green Hags mimic lost children's cries out of mist-filled hollows. Greenhorns who follow the voice wander straight into thorny snares.

mob_owlbear.threatSummary: Ferocious feathered Owlbears tear timber carts to splinters whenever sawyers cross within half a league of their hollow-root nests.

mob_wereboar.threatSummary: Stubborn scarred Wereboars gore straight through spear lines in wild fury. They flatten woodland fences and root cellars alike.

mob_lamia.threatSummary: Trickster Lamias weave glittering illusions across overgrown clearings. Befuddled scouts drop their guard long before steel comes out.

mob_ghost.threatSummary: Restless Ghosts cling to ruined forest shrines along quiet trails. Their bone-deep terror drains courage and scatters loyal patrols into the trees.

mob_succubus.threatSummary: Winged Succubi slip along lonely woodland clearings to charm watch captains. One careless officer can unlock an entire garrison postern gate from within.

mob_chuul.threatSummary: Gigantic lobster-plated Chuuls lurk motionless beneath murky channel banks. They paralyze armored scouts with venom-tipped feelers.

mob_giant_crocodile.threatSummary: Twenty-foot Giant Crocodiles drift like mossy logs along ferry approaches. One snap splits oars and rowboats cleanly in two.

mob_shadow_demon.threatSummary: Clawed Shadow Demons crept out of dark Rotspire fissures. They dart through blighted canopy gloom where torchlight barely reaches.

mob_troll.threatSummary: Lanky moss-skinned Trolls haunt isolated clearings. Their torn flesh knits shut mid-battle unless seared cleanly with fire.

mob_night_hag.threatSummary: Sinister blue-skinned Night Hags gather around toadstool rings. Their foul curses leave frontier sentries too drained by waking nightmares to stand watch.

mob_gladiator.threatSummary: Pit-hardened Gladiators turned into merciless highway killers along wilderness clearings. Heavy arena blades let them carve straight through raw militia.

mob_flesh_golem.threatSummary: Rotspire lightning shocks drove hulking patchwork Flesh Golems into motion. They march tirelessly through toxic mire with zero fear of pain.

mob_wraith.threatSummary: Life-draining Wraiths crowned in cold embers glide straight through wooden stockade walls. They snuff out campfires and sentries without a sound.

mob_vampire_spawn.threatSummary: Feral Vampire Spawn nest high inside blighted pine boughs. They drop silently onto twilight patrols passing quarantine markers.

mob_hill_giant.threatSummary: Bumbling twelve-foot Hill Giants smash mountain cattle sheds and foothill windmills simply to devour everything inside in one sitting.

mob_bulette.threatSummary: Plate-shelled Bulettes burst straight up through soft foothill turf like breaching whales, swallowing pack mules whole.

mob_pirate_captain.threatSummary: Notorious Pirate Captains seize sheltered coves along coastal beaches. They turn quiet bays and wrecks into armed corsair dens.

mob_salamander.threatSummary: Bronze-scaled fiery Salamanders slither out of scorched rock cracks. Their white-hot iron spears blister wooden shields on contact.

mob_fire_elemental.threatSummary: Living Fire Elementals spilled out of The Scorched Chasm. They ignite caravan canvas and boil desert water springs dry.

mob_barbed_devil.threatSummary: Spiny Barbed Devils prowl red sandstone mesas. Their razor hides shred careless swordsmen who close in blindly.

mob_mage.threatSummary: Rogue Mages defied Highcrown's old arcane bans and fled to the frontier. Now they hurl volatile flame and storm spells across open mesas.

mob_chimera.threatSummary: Triple-headed Chimeras combine lion fangs, goat horns, and flame-belching dragon jaws. They pick camel trains cleanly off cliff ledges.

mob_wyvern.threatSummary: Venom-tailed Wyverns nest high along tall stone spires. Their dripping stingers drop armored cavalry in seconds.

mob_water_elemental.threatSummary: Portal currents stirred up churning Water Elementals along local shores. They drag thirsty travelers under lakes and coastal shallows.

byRegion.desert: Portal currents stirred up churning Water Elementals inside desert oasis springs and coastal inlets. They drag parched caravans under warm surf.
byRegion.highlands: Portal currents stirred up churning Water Elementals across Ironcrest's alpine lake shores. They sweep fishermen and pack mules cleanly off rocky banks.

mob_young_black_dragon.threatSummary: Cunning horned Young Black Dragons staked claims across sunken salt-lakes. They hoard caravan brass beneath clouds of blistering acid mist.

mob_oni.threatSummary: Giant horned Oni shapeshifters disguise themselves as trail guides. They lure spice merchants straight into silent palm-grove ambushes.

mob_vrock.threatSummary: Screeching vulture-feathered Vrocks dive over exposed ridges. They shake loose choking spore-clouds and deafening cries to scatter pack beasts.

byRegion.desert: Screeching vulture-feathered Vrocks dive over blazing desert dunes. They shake loose choking spore-clouds to scatter spice caravans.
byRegion.highlands: Screeching vulture-feathered Vrocks wheel down from granite Ironcrest crags. Their deafening shrieks scatter ore trains across narrow ledges.

mob_invisible_stalker.threatSummary: Bound Invisible Stalkers drift unseen on hot swirling winds. They slit water-skins and pick off outriders without leaving a single footprint.

mob_stone_giant.threatSummary: Stoic Stone Giants carve boulder ambushes atop mesas and granite peaks. Their hurled rocks shatter outpost walls from beyond bowshot range.

mob_young_white_dragon.threatSummary: Savage Young White Dragons nest along windy granite passes. Their freezing breath turns copper storm-wards brittle as glass.

mob_young_copper_dragon.threatSummary: Mining hammers roused territorial Young Copper Dragons along highland crags. They ambush ore carts with sizzling sprays of acid.

mob_shield_guardian.threatSummary: Masterless iron Shield Guardians patrol abandoned foothill depots without sleep or mercy. They crush anyone approaching without ancient seals.

mob_assassin.threatSummary: Poison-cloaked Assassins slip beneath pine canopies to silence envoys carrying star-iron treaties between mountain holds.

mob_hydra.threatSummary: Multi-headed Hydras coil inside rocky shore coves. Every severed neck sprouts two snapping heads unless seared shut cleanly.

mob_young_green_dragon.threatSummary: Calculating Young Green Dragons wrap pine valleys in choking poison clouds. Those who survive the fumes face silver-tongued threats to betray timber forts.

mob_frost_giant.threatSummary: Eighteen-foot Frost Giants raid high passes for tempered steel ingots and salted cattle.

byRegion.highlands: Eighteen-foot Frost Giants wandered onto Ironcrest's highest chill passes. They smash smelter carts for tempered steel ingots and mountain cattle.
byRegion.frostbound: Eighteen-foot Frost Giants march down snowy Frostbound glaciers with ice-forged greataxes. They sack northern clan halls and coastal sled trains.

mob_chain_devil.threatSummary: Infernal Chain Devils animate barbed iron chains out of thin air. They drag mountain miners away in clinking torment.

mob_cloaker.threatSummary: Deceptive Cloakers fold like black wool capes over cave rocks. The moment a traveler steps close, they snap shut around head and shoulders.

mob_clay_golem.threatSummary: Portal quakes drove ancient Clay Golems berserk. They pound forward with cursed fists whose wounds stubbornly resist healing.

mob_hezrou.threatSummary: Bloated abyssal Hezrous swarm quiet lakesides. Foul skin fumes rot rope bridges and rust forged iron armor.

mob_cloud_giant.threatSummary: Towering Cloud Giants gather inside whistling alpine mist below Stormhold. They levy steep iron-tribute tolls across every high pass.

mob_young_silver_dragon.threatSummary: Storm-Crown sparks drove Young Silver Dragons half-mad atop high ridges. They rain freezing gales upon anyone climbing near their eyries.

mob_young_blue_dragon.threatSummary: Sapphire-horned Young Blue Dragons circle storm-swept peaks and coves like living thunderclouds. They spear signal beacons with blinding arcs of lightning.

mob_bone_devil.threatSummary: Insectoid Bone Devils bark cold orders to lesser fiends along mountain approaches. Their dripping tail-spikes skewer shield-men clean through mail.

mob_glabrezu.threatSummary: Colossal four-armed Glabrezus stalk dark pine roads. They tear wagon teams apart while whispering dark bargains to terrified guards.

mob_warrior_commander.threatSummary: Banner-bearing Warrior Commanders drill hostile shock companies across the heights. They drive coordinated assaults straight against loyalist mountain outposts.

mob_cultist_hierophant.threatSummary: Crimson-stole Cultist Hierophants conduct midnight Portal rituals inside evergreen woods. Every completed rite pulls larger terrors into Ethoria.

mob_stone_golem.threatSummary: Chiselled Stone Golems stomp across broken flagstones with relentless weight. Their crushing aura turns charging soldiers' legs as leaden as wet stone.

mob_bandit_crime_lord.threatSummary: Cold-blooded Bandit Crime Lords choke frozen northern cargo routes with poisoned daggers and bands of hired raiders.

mob_guardian_naga.threatSummary: Frozen rift magic twisted once-patient Guardian Nagas mad. Now they spit blinding venom across snowy taiga trails.

mob_roc.threatSummary: Mountain-sized Rocs sweep low across northern ridges. Their wingbeats flatten pine stands before they pluck whole freight sleds clean off the trail.

mob_remorhaz.threatSummary: Furnace-backed Remorhazes burn white-hot along their ridged spines. They melt solid glacier tunnels straight underneath passing sled patrols.

mob_djinni.threatSummary: Storm-born Djinni duelists sweep across open snowfields. They trap entire sentry lines inside spinning tornadoes of biting sleet.

mob_young_red_dragon.threatSummary: Fierce Young Red Dragons claim smoky crag lairs to roast patrols and hoard plundered steel.

byRegion.frostbound: Fierce Young Red Dragons melt wide steam-craters across Frostbound snowfields. They burn timber palisades down to guard stolen clan silver.
byRegion.dreadwaste: Fierce Young Red Dragons claim smoldering obsidian ledges in The Dreadwaste. They scorch vanguard scouts along Black Keep's outer approaches.

mob_behir.threatSummary: Twelve-legged Behirs cling to jagged cliff faces and loose crackling lightning arcs straight through steel armor.

byRegion.frostbound: Twelve-legged sapphire Behirs slither down icy Frostbound crags. They snap blizzard convoys cleanly with crackling lightning arcs.
byRegion.dreadwaste: Twelve-legged Behirs coil along jagged Dreadwaste basalt ridges. They fry siege scouts with arcing bolts out of the ash fog.

mob_horned_devil.threatSummary: Winged Horned Devils dive off steep cliffs with jagged iron forks that inflict searing infernal wounds.

byRegion.frostbound: Winged Horned Devils dive off snow-packed Frostbound cliffs with burning iron forks. They scatter glacier picket lines before relief arrives.
byRegion.dreadwaste: Winged Horned Devils wheel cleanly through Dreadwaste ash clouds. They harry supply trains along Black Keep's basalt perimeter.

mob_sphinx_of_lore.threatSummary: Winged Sphinxes of Lore bar high ridge trails to test doomed frontier patrols. Anyone who fails their riddle faces warped time and shattering blows.

mob_archmage.threatSummary: Rogue Archmages conjure protective wards and hurl devastating arcane blasts across the outer frontier.

byRegion.frostbound: Rogue Archmages conjure razor sleet and arcane wards inside Frostbound icefields. Northern relief columns shatter before reaching range.
byRegion.dreadwaste: Dark-robed Archmages hold Garrick's outer approaches atop Dreadwaste ash flats. They blanket vanguard camps in lethal meteoric fire.

mob_erinyes.threatSummary: Cold-eyed winged Erinyes descend from stormy skies with blackened longbows and poisoned blades to hunt elite patrols.

mob_pirate_admiral.threatSummary: Notorious Pirate Admirals blockade deep-water coves and outer bays with armored hulls and merciless saber crews.

mob_rakshasa.threatSummary: Tiger-faced Rakshasas wear stolen nobles' silks and shrug off ordinary spells while tearing unwary scouts apart.

mob_vampire.threatSummary: Immortal Vampires stalk shadowed ruins and border ridges to drain patrols before vanishing into bat-clouds.

byRegion.frostbound: Immortal Vampires stalk misty northern pines and frozen ruins. They drain Frostbound patrols dry before vanishing into bat-clouds.
byRegion.dreadwaste: Immortal Vampires stalk shadowed ruins and border ridges along Dreadwaste's north wall. Scouts vanish into the dark leaving only drained armor behind.

mob_storm_giant.threatSummary: Titanic Storm Giants stride along shattered shores as tempest winds churn around their ankles. Their hurled thunderbolts split vanguard ships in half.

mob_adult_black_dragon.threatSummary: Ancient-scarred Adult Black Dragons blanket frontier approaches in corrosive acid mist that melts steel walls and bone alike.

byRegion.frostbound: Ancient-scarred Adult Black Dragons smash straight up through Frostbound frozen lakes. They dissolve timber watch-posts inside steaming pools of emerald acid.
byRegion.dreadwaste: Ancient-scarred Adult Black Dragons roost amid charred Dreadwaste ash pools. They bathe Garrick's outer approaches in blistering acid mist.

mob_ice_devil.threatSummary: Insectoid Ice Devils march out of The Pale Abyss to raise walls of razor-sharp black ice around marching columns.

byRegion.frostbound: Insectoid Ice Devils march straight off The Pale Abyss glacier walls. They seal frozen passes behind barriers of cursed black ice.
byRegion.dreadwaste: Insectoid Ice Devils sweep south from The Pale Abyss into Dreadwaste border passes. Their freezing spears turn ash dust into razor ice-barriers.

mob_nalfeshnee.threatSummary: Monstrous boar-faced Nalfeshnees boom across charred ash plains. Their blinding nimbus flashes leave entire regiments paralyzed in the open.

mob_purple_worm.threatSummary: House-wide Purple Worms churn straight through solid basalt beneath Dreadwaste roads. They burst out of the rock to swallow supply wagons whole.

mob_marilith.threatSummary: Serpent-tailed Mariliths whirl six enchanted blades at once. Entire shield-wall formations buckle in moments whenever they close in.

mob_mummy_lord.threatSummary: Crown-wearing undead Mummy Lords march across ash ridges wrapped in ancient curses and roaring necromantic storms.

mob_adult_green_dragon.threatSummary: Cunning Adult Green Dragons blanket basalt passes in deadly fumes to choke vanguard companies before Black Keep's gates.

mob_iron_golem.threatSummary: Black Keep's dark foundries forged towering solid-metal Iron Golems. They breathe toxic furnace gas while shrugging off steel and flame.

mob_adult_silver_dragon.threatSummary: Shadowfell distortion twisted mighty Adult Silver Dragons into wrathful tyrants atop volcanic scree. Their paralyzing frost locks down every aerial approach.

mob_adult_red_dragon.threatSummary: Imperious Adult Red Dragons claim smoldering Dreadwaste calderas. They incinerate vanguard camps beneath roaring walls of dragonfire.

mob_balor.threatSummary: Towering horned Balors stalk the scarred approaches to Black Keep. They sweep aside whole pickets with lightning longswords and blazing whips.

mob_ancient_black_dragon.threatSummary: Centuries-old Ancient Black Dragons melt obsidian ridges into bubbling pools of green death. Few beasts outside Black Keep are deadlier.

mob_lich.threatSummary: Undying skeletal Liches cling to forbidden power inside Garrick's inner wasteland. They shatter advancing formations with swift death-spells.

mob_dragon_turtle.threatSummary: Island-shelled Dragon Turtles rise off dark volcanic shores to scald blockade ships in jets of superheated steam.
